text: In which landmark judgment delivered in 2016, did the Supreme Court issue guidelines on drought management to the Government of India?
option_a: Swaraj Abhiyan Vs Union of India
option_c: Common Cause Vs Union of India
option_d: Mahipal Singh Rana Vs State of UP
explanation: The Swaraj Abhiyan v. Union of India (2016) judgment laid down guidelines on drought management and relief.

text: Out of the following, which is not a power granted to Rajya Sabha?
option_a: Authorizing Parliament in the national interest to make a law on a matter in the State List
option_b: Authorizing State Assemblies in the national interest to make law on matters in the Union List
option_c: To return a Money Bill with recommendations
option_d: Authorizing Parliament in the national interest to make a law for creation of an All India Service
explanation: The Rajya Sabha can authorise Parliament (Arts 249, 312) to legislate on State List or create All-India Services, but it cannot authorise State Assemblies to legislate on the Union List.

text: Which of the following could be one of the reasons for pruning of development targets of the second five year plan?
option_a: Non-availability of foreign collaborators to set up heavy industries
option_d: Failure of bureaucracy to implement developmental schemes
explanation: The Second Plan's heavy-industry drive triggered a severe foreign-exchange crisis, forcing targets to be pruned.

text: Out of the options below, what was the issue of emphasis in the sixth five year plan put forward for 1978-83 by the Government of the Janata Party?
explanation: The Janata Government's 1978-83 rolling plan emphasised employment generation and removal of poverty.

text: From which five year plan was the system of setting "monitorable targets" for key indicators of development introduced?
explanation: The Tenth Plan (2002-07) introduced monitorable targets for key socio-economic indicators.

text: Which organization is entrusted with the initiative of converting 100% Government – Citizen transactions to the digital platform?
option_b: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
explanation: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) drives the Digital India goal of digitising government-to-citizen services.

text: Which of the following is not one of the subjects on which a sub group of chief ministers is constituted by NITI Aayog as part of Cooperative Federalism?
explanation: NITI Aayog constituted sub-groups of Chief Ministers on centrally sponsored schemes, skill development and Swachh Bharat; digital payments was handled by a separate later committee.

text: The debate between Bhagawati and Sen on the economic policy of India revolves on
option_b: Economic Growth first versus Investment in Social Infrastructure first
explanation: Bhagwati stressed growth-led development first; Sen stressed prior investment in social infrastructure (health, education).

text: The most important reason for higher absolute increase in urban population in India compared to rural population in the decade from 2001 to 2011 could be due to
option_a: migration from rural to urban areas
option_b: higher death rate in rural areas due to lesser access to medical facilities
option_c: better methods of birth control in rural areas
option_d: categorization of erstwhile rural areas as urban areas
explanation: A large part of the 2001-11 urban rise came from the reclassification of rural settlements as 'census towns'.

text: As per census 2011, between 2001 and 2011
option_a: farmers increased and farm labourers decreased
option_b: farmers increased and farm labourers increased
option_c: farmers decreased and farm labourers decreased
option_d: farmers decreased and farm labourers increased
explanation: Census 2011 showed a fall in the number of cultivators (farmers) and a rise in agricultural labourers.

text: As per the statistics of the National Crime Records Bureau (ADSI 2015), the biggest reason for suicide of farmers in India is
option_d: illness, drug abuse and alcohol addiction
explanation: ADSI 2015 attributed the largest share of farmer suicides to bankruptcy or indebtedness.

text: Which of the following is not a component of Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)?
explanation: PMKSY comprises AIBP, Har Khet ko Pani, Per Drop More Crop and Watershed Development; a National Water Grid is not a component.

text: The MOU to be signed by the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) (approved by Union Cabinet in April, 2017) is on cooperation in
explanation: The BIMSTEC MoU approved in April 2017 was for grid interconnection in the power sector.

text: Which of the following is a demand side intervention in the UDAY (Ujjwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana) Scheme of the Central Government?
option_c: Usage of energy efficient LED bulbs
explanation: Promoting energy-efficient LED bulbs reduces demand — a demand-side measure under UDAY.

text: With regard to funding of the Polavaram Project, the Centre would provide
option_a: 100% of the cost of the irrigation component for the period starting from 01/04/2014 to the extent of the cost as on that date
option_b: 100% of the cost of the irrigation component as incurred
option_c: 100% of the cost of the irrigation component as per value decided by the Centre
option_d: 100% of the cost of the full project for the period starting from 01/04/2014 to the extent of the cost as on that date
explanation: Under the AP Reorganisation Act, the Centre funds 100% of the remaining cost of the irrigation component of Polavaram as on 01/04/2014.

text: The coach with glass roof and other facilities in the Visakhapatnam–Araku Train is known as
explanation: The glass-roofed tourist coach on the Visakhapatnam–Araku route is the Vistadome coach.

text: Which institute is the academic mentor for the Indian Institute of Petroleum and Energy (IIPE), Visakhapatnam?
option_a: Petroleum Conservation and Research Agency, Delhi
explanation: IIT Kharagpur was designated the academic mentor for IIPE Visakhapatnam.

text: Which of the following parameters had the highest weightage for calculating tax devolution from Centre to States as per the recommendations of the 14th Finance Commission?
explanation: The 14th Finance Commission gave the highest weight (50%) to income distance in the horizontal devolution formula.

text: Which year is taken as the basis for resources for making recommendations by the 14th Finance Commission?
explanation: The 14th Finance Commission departed from the base-year approach and did not adopt a base year for assessing resources.

text: Which of the following is one of the factors not considered by the 14th Finance Commission in vertical devolution of resources?
option_b: Concerns of States and Centre on fiscal space
option_c: Differential levels in aspirations and expectations of the population of various States
option_d: Need for clarity on functional and expenditure responsibilities of States and Centre in the interest of sound federal fiscal relations
explanation: Differential aspirations of populations relate to horizontal (inter-state) sharing, not to vertical (Centre-States) devolution.

text: Compositional shift from grants to tax devolution from Centre to State causes
option_a: additional fiscal burden on the Centre
option_b: increase in share of unconditional transfers to States
option_c: demand from States to increase tax rates
option_d: lack of fiscal space to carry out specific purpose transfer to States
explanation: Tax devolution is untied/unconditional, so shifting from grants to tax devolution raises the share of unconditional transfers to States.

text: The relationship in India between redistributive resource transfers from the Centre to States and various economic outcomes like per capita consumption, growth in GDP, tax revenue effort is
explanation: Studies cited by the 14th FC found redistributive transfers negatively correlated with outcomes such as own tax effort and growth.

text: Muga silk is a product of the silkworm endemic to which State of India?
explanation: Muga silk, the golden silk, is endemic to Assam.

text: As per the rationalization of Centrally Sponsored Schemes by the Government of India, "core of the core" schemes are
option_a: Social protection and Social inclusion schemes
option_b: Schemes which are part of National Agenda
explanation: 'Core of the Core' schemes are those for social protection and social inclusion of the most vulnerable (e.g., MGNREGA, umbrella SC/ST schemes).

text: What is the meaning of competitive sub-federalism in the context of achieving targets on social and developmental goals?
option_d: Local Bodies competing with Local Bodies
explanation: Competitive federalism refers to States competing with one another to attract investment and improve outcomes.

text: Which of the following programmes of the Government of India does not provide opportunity for urban rejuvenation?
explanation: The Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission targets rural clusters, not urban rejuvenation.

text: A recent radical idea to overcome the problem of poor targeting and misallocation of social welfare schemes is that of
option_c: Direct allocation of funds to Local Bodies
explanation: The Economic Survey 2016-17 floated Universal Basic Income as a radical alternative to poorly targeted welfare schemes.

text: What is the all India participation rate of Women in MNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Agency) Scheme in 2016 – 17?
explanation: Women's participation in MGNREGA in 2016-17 was about 56%.

text: The Inter State Council was established on the recommendations of
explanation: The Inter-State Council (1990) was set up on the recommendation of the Sarkaria Commission.

text: "Cooperative Federalism" in Centre – State relations is recommended for the first time by
explanation: The Sarkaria Commission first emphasised cooperative federalism in Centre-State relations.

text: Out of the following, which is a recommendation of the M.M. Punchhi Commission on the institution of Governor?
option_a: Provision for impeachment of the Governor may be introduced by the State Legislature
option_b: The system of Governor may be abolished
option_c: Consent of Chief Minister of a State shall be necessary before appointing Governor of the State
option_d: Governors should be periodically rotated between States
explanation: The Punchhi Commission recommended a provision for the impeachment of the Governor by the State Legislature.

text: Which of the following is a principle followed by the farmers who are participants to the APFAMGS (Andhra Pradesh Farmer Managed Groundwater Systems) Project?
option_b: Rules are set by users and not by outsiders
option_d: Fixed rules which are not amenable to change are made
explanation: APFAMGS follows the community-managed principle that rules for groundwater use are set by the users themselves.

text: What was the immediate cause for loss of foreign reserves triggering the financial crisis in 1991?
option_c: Sharp rise in value of imports of oil & petroleum products
option_d: Stoppage of rupee trade by the Soviet Bloc
explanation: The Gulf War (1990-91) caused a sharp rise in the value of oil imports, rapidly depleting India's forex reserves.

text: Which move helped to tide over the balance of payment crisis in 1991?
option_a: Sale of gold in international markets
option_b: Emergency loan from IMF by pledging gold reserves
explanation: India pledged gold reserves to raise an emergency loan from the IMF to overcome the 1991 BoP crisis.

text: Which of the following sectors was not much affected by the reforms after 1991?
explanation: Railways remained a government monopoly and was largely untouched by the post-1991 liberalisation.

text: What could be the main reason for jobless growth in the reform period after 1991?
option_a: Reforms were mainly confined to the formal sector
option_b: Majority of the labour force was already employed and hence there was no need for jobs
option_c: The informal sector opposed the reforms and new industries could not be opened
option_d: People were not willing to do menial jobs
explanation: Post-1991 reforms were largely confined to the organised/formal sector, which employs a small share of the workforce, leading to jobless growth.

text: Under the new Central GST Bill, 2017, the mechanism to monitor and ensure that any reduction in tax rate should result in a commensurate reduction in the price of goods or services is known as
explanation: The anti-profiteering measure ensures the benefit of a tax-rate cut is passed on to consumers via lower prices.

text: Under the scheme of new GST Bills, 2017, subject to a ceiling fixed under GST Act, the changes in GST rates can normally be effected by
option_b: Government with prior approval of President
explanation: Within the ceiling set by the Act, GST rates are changed by the Government through notification, on the GST Council's recommendation.
